claims.text: School failure, poor attendance, or new struggles: need investigation; often = an unrecognized learning disability, ADHD, or stressors such as family dysfun and divorce, bullying @ school, or depression in the child or parent.
claims.quote: School failure, poor school attendance, or new struggles require investigation, as they frequently indicate an unrecognized learning disability, ADHD, or the effect of stressors, such as family dysfunction and divorce, bullying at school, or depression in the child or parent.
claims.locator: 9 and 10 Year Visits, Surveillance of Development

claims.text: Absences, truancy, poor school performance: identify the problem ASAP; assessment may incl sensory screening, psychosocial screening, and Refer for LD and mental dx assessment.
claims.quote: Therefore, the nature of problems revealed in excessive absences, truancy, or poor school performance needs to be identified as soon as possible. Assessments may include sensory screening, psychosocial screening, and referrals for the assessment and diagnosis of learning disabilities and mental disorders so that appropriate treatments can begin.
claims.locator: 7 and 8 Year Visits, Surveillance of Development

claims.text: Bullying: bullying, teasing, and feeling left out can interfere w norm development and school performance; children w disabilities and other special health care needs = @ ↑risk.
claims.quote: Bullying, teasing, and feeling left out can interfere with normal development and school performance. Assist parents in being observant for signs of bullying and ostracism. Children with disabilities and other special health care needs are at increased risk of bullying.
